SHIPPED: Word-level timestamps in CLI JSON output
SIGNIFICANCE: Enables frame-accurate Remotion TikTok-style word highlighting — drops hacky proportional character-length splitter entirely
COMMIT: 327f74a — 'feat(cli): word-level timestamps in JSON output via Whisper DTW'

OUTPUT FORMAT:
```json
{
  "text": "Full transcript here",
  "words": [
    { "text": " Full", "start_ms": 0, "end_ms": 320 },
    { "text": " transcript", "start_ms": 320, "end_ms": 780 }
  ],
  "segments": [ { ...per-segment words array... } ]
}
```

FILES CHANGED:
- src-tauri/src/features/transcription/types.rs — WordTiming struct, words field on SegmentTiming
- src-tauri/src/features/transcription/whisper_utils.rs — token text extraction + tokens_to_words()
- src-tauri/src/features/transcription/whisper.rs — DtwParameters at context creation
- src-tauri/src/features/transcription/strategy_traits.rs — words field
- src-tauri/src/cli.rs — JsonWord struct, top-level words array, per-segment words

ENABLES: Ned's Remotion pipeline can now use real word timestamps
